summary: This short note is a Wikipedia-style biography of Lin Chih-chieh, a Taiwanese professional basketball player of Amis descent, born in Hualien County in 1982. It highlights his career with the Taiwan Beer club in the Super Basketball League, where he won MVP and scoring titles. The note also describes his popularity in Taiwan and his nickname "The Beast". The note is brief and does not cover his early life or wider career in detail.
one_line: Taiwanese professional basketball player of Amis descent who starred for Taiwan Beer in the Super Basketball League.
key_facts: Lin Chih-chieh was born on 11 June 1982 in Hualien County, Taiwan.
Lin Chih-chieh is a Taiwanese professional basketball player of Amis descent.
Lin Chih-chieh played for the Taiwan Beer club of the Super Basketball League (SBL).
Lin Chih-chieh has won one Regular Season most valuable player (MVP) award in the SBL.
Lin Chih-chieh has won two back-to-back Championship Series MVP awards.
Lin Chih-chieh has won two scoring champion titles.
Local media dubbed Lin Chih-chieh "The Beast" (野獸).
Lin Chih-chieh is renowned for his ability to boost his team's morale by making sensational plays.
Lin Chih-chieh is among the most beloved basketball players in Taiwan.
